conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Grace Koehler (Mrs. Charles) Liebman, New York, NY, gift, 1928; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); The artist, purchase, 1950; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1958; William Zierler, Inc., New York, NY, 1970; (Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Private collection, Chattanooga, Tennessee, 1973; Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY, 1974; (Joshua Strychalski, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Note: Letter from Grace Koehler, 1010 5th Ave. to A.S. in 1928 thanking him for O'Keeffe painting." In 1950 Edith Halpert wrote O'Keeffe that a Mrs. Liebman had brought it [the painting] in, having received it as a gift from O'Keeffe and indicated: "Doris discovered she was Grace Koehler and got the painting in 1928" (21 October 1950, Archive of American Art). In response O'Keeffe wrote: "I can not definitely remember the incident –– I never knew Grace Koehler –– tho I may have met her –– It probably has something to do with Stieglitz brother, the doctor –– I will write and ask him because I just cant remember. . . . It is some one I never knew" (O'Keeffe to Edith Halpert, 25 October 1950, Archive of American Art). Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: By A.S. 'Autumn Leaf with White Flower' by Georgia O'Keeffe. 1926" [not verified]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Autum Leaf with White Flower

description: In this narrow, semiabstract composition, a white flower with a green center floats in front of a large black leaf that stretches the length of the canvas. The background is a gradient fading from black at the bottom to white at the very top.
title: Autum Leaf with White Flower
